knowledge_target: The correct command to run TypeScript type checking in this project is `bun run type-check-pure` (which runs `tsc --noEmit`), not `npm run type-check`. The command `bun run type-check` additionally requires a CLJS build first. For running a specific unit test file, the command is `bun run test-unit-keep-cljs path/to/file.unit.spec.ts`.
